hero.subtext: I'm Nate Winter, a Milwaukee-based designer and art director focused on product-led brands. I build the visual world around a product, starting in 3D for control a camera can't match, then carrying it through motion, packaging, and campaign work, so it lands sharper, more premium, and impossible to ignore.

about.title: Strong creative direction, rendered honestly.
about.lead: I'm a Milwaukee-based designer and art director. I treat 3D less like a render pass and more like visual art direction, where the goal isn't just to make a product look real, but to make it feel considered, premium, and right for the brand it belongs to.
about.body1: I came up through graphic design before going deep on 3D, and that foundation still runs through everything, the composition, the type, the restraint. It's why the brand and packaging work sits naturally next to the renders, and why I care as much about the strategy and the small material decisions as the final frame.
about.body2: Engagements usually run a few weeks to a couple of months, often a hero piece plus the system around it, though I'm just as happy with a single deliverable or ongoing creative direction. If it's a product worth getting right, it's worth a conversation.

services.title: Product animation
services.desc: Launch films, scroll-stopping loops, and paid-social cutdowns, built to make the product feel alive in motion. All on one locked art direction, so every frame stays of a piece.

services.title: Product stills
services.desc: Photoreal 3D stills for PDPs, paid social, retail, and Amazon A+, with control a camera can't give you. Drawn from the same visual system as the film, so the whole campaign reads as one thing.

services.title: Brand & packaging design
services.desc: Identity systems, packaging, label design, and the visual language that earns the shelf. Often paired with a stills library, so the brand lands cohesive from day one.

services.title: Creative direction & consulting
services.desc: Visual strategy, campaign direction, and production guidance, by the day or week. For teams that want sharper creative decisions and an art-directed set of eyes on the brief.

contact.title: Have a product that needs a stronger visual world? Let's talk.
contact.lead: I take a range of projects each quarter, from single deliverables and short engagements to multi-month campaigns and ongoing creative direction. Also open to full-time and contract roles with the right team. Share your scope, timeline, or opportunity. A short note is all I need to get started.
expect: I reply within two business days.
We hop on a 30-minute fit call.
You get a fixed-scope proposal within a week.
